program: Wingless fixed-budget prospective diagnostic failure attribution
question: Why did R3 flag zero-support classes 5, 6, and 7 while the code target exercised none of them: were those classes absent from the target representation, or present but suppressed by the repaired reasoning bridge?
hypothesis: Replay the exact R3 training sources, 15,819-byte training budget, 256-motif capacity, 8x32 class partition, repaired relation, and 1,454-byte code target. Freeze the R3 zero-support class set {5,6,7}. Add only attribution metrics on the already-opened target: per class, count raw decoded target motif occurrences, repaired depth-3 top-1 occurrences, and cumulative repaired probability mass. Each zero-support class receives exactly one frozen attribution: target_representation_absence if raw decoded target motif count is zero; bridge_suppression if raw decoded target motif count is positive but repaired top-1 count is zero; diagnostic_active if repaired top-1 count is positive. No representation, relation, class assignment, capacity, threshold, data split, or diagnostic rule changes.

portfolio_context.role: advisory-only; optimize future-data learning efficiency, not self-modification

prior_evidence.diagnosis: The support diagnostic produced a prospective false positive: it flagged three training-empty classes, but the code target never used them as repaired top-1.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

attribution_rules.target_representation_absence: raw decoded target motif count for the zero-support class == 0
attribution_rules.bridge_suppression: raw decoded target motif count > 0 AND repaired top-1 count == 0

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes; all three zero-support classes receive exactly one frozen attribution and the R3 target-top1 absence reproduces with complete accounting.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but the frozen attribution rules cannot account for one or more zero-support classes.
classification_rules.invalid: Any parent, authority, source, budget, representation, class, relation, target-query identity, determinism, provenance, or qualification criterion fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter R3 source identities, budgets, 256 capacity, 8x32 class partition, zero-support class set, target bytes, repaired relation, attribution rules, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_representation_absence_domi.intent: replace zero-support-class diagnosis with a preregistered target-agnostic learning-efficiency signal based on training coverage/prediction statistics, then test it on a new future dataset under fixed budgets

successor_if_bridge_suppression_dominate.intent: attribute which repaired-bridge transition suppresses target-represented unsupported classes before proposing any bounded mechanism change
